messages:
marie: opening a small PR to refresh the hello-starter quickstart — aim is clearer auth examples, unify Node/Python to SDK v6, and shorten the 'first deploy' checklist. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1450

noah: awesome. can we stop using `TOKEN` in examples? prefer `REDWOOD_API_KEY` for hosted and call out `REDWOOD_TOKEN` for on-prem.

marie: agreed. I'll show both but label hosted as recommended. also adding a tiny GH Actions secret example for CI.

vikram: nit: the Node snippet currently misses the `require` line after the refactor. snip-checker will catch it but flag early pls.

snip-checker: snippet-run results: hello-starter/node/example.md: error at line 10 - ReferenceError: Redwood is not defined.

marie: thanks, fixing import now: `const { Redwood } = require('@redwood/inference')` and adding language tags to codeblocks.

noah: found a stale link to token FAQ (docs/token-mgmt.md) — should point to docs/auth/tokens.md. can you update?

marie: updated link and pushed. also added a brief migration note for v4 -> v6 (constructor rename + streaming example).

snip-checker: re-run: all snippets passed.

gh-actions: PR #1450 preview deployed: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/hello-starter (checks green).

marie: thanks y'all. will merge once CI stays green and then add a changelog blurb.

noah: happy to proof the CI secrets wording after merge.

vikram: I'll follow up with a short upgrade HOWTO for SDK v4 users next sprint.

marie: closing thread after merge. thanks everyone! :tada:
